preconditions.description: The input must be a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: any(c in 'aeiou' for c in input_str)
preconditions.description: The input string must contain at least one vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u').

postconditions.description: The result is a float between 0 and 100 (inclusive), representing the rounded trump score.
The result is rounded to two decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all(vowel in 'aeiou' for vowel in set(vowels))
postconditions.description: Only the vowels 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u' are considered in the calculation.

postconditions.expression: total_vowels == len([c for c in input_str if c in 'aeiou'])
postconditions.description: total_vowels is the count of all vowels in the input string.

postconditions.expression: extra_vowels == sum(max(0, len(group) - 1) for group in vowel_groups)
postconditions.description: extra_vowels is the sum of (length of each vowel group - 1) for all vowel groups in the input string.

postconditions.expression: vowel_groups == [group for group in re.findall(r'([aeiou]+)', input_str.lower())]
postconditions.description: vowel_groups is a list of contiguous vowel sequences in the input string (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == round(extra_vowels / total_vowels, 2) if total_vowels > 0 else 0.0
postconditions.description: The result is the ratio of extra_vowels to total_vowels, rounded to two decimal places.
